title: Recent rotations
message: Best 3 each way. A bullish rotation climbed into the top 10 from the wider pack. A bearish rotation was a top-3 leader and has slipped. These are not buy or sell orders.

bullish.blurb: Was about #17 outside the top 10, now #10. 1-month return +2.2%.

bearish.blurb: Was about #1 in the top 3, now #9. 1-month return +2.4%.
